Lina: quick flag: sable-v1 int8 onboard eval shows detok bidi oddness for CJK + RTL. small repro below.
Kofi: paste the short repro pls.
Lina: input: 日本語 〈مرحبا〉 end -> output: 日本語 〈‏مرحبا〉 end (RLM inserted before arabic span). only on int8 cuda q5; fp16/float32 clean.
Sana: did you capture tokenizer ids and recon?
Lina: tokens: [1012, 33, 4807, 9001, 77] recon: 日本語 〈‏مرحبا〉 end
EvalBot: ran 1.5k mixed-locale samples. zh->ar BLEU delta = -5.1 vs fp16. bracket flip / RLM in 3.9% of examples.
Kofi: sounds like a detok-stage bidi normalization path for quant kernels. can you try disabling "detok-bidi-fast" flag?
Lina: disabled it in canary; immediate improvement in sampled set. Will add unit test (CJK punctuation + RTL) and open kernel bisect ticket: kernel/unicode @ a9d2..b1f4.
Sana: good. Ops, any customer impact?
OpsBot: auto-fallback triggered on routes: prod/translate-mea at 2026-03-23T09:14Z for sable-v1 int8.
Kofi: next: add locale-specific evals (ja->ar, zh->he), run chrF/COMET, and prioritize kernel bisect. Assigning to @Kofi.
Lina: repro script: tools/repro_bidi_sable.sh 〈مرحبا〉 in repo.
Sana: will coordinate with L10n for more punctuation-heavy samples.
Kofi: ETA for bisect end of day tomorrow. posting results here.
Lina: thanks, adding release note blurb: "known detok bidi artifact for CJK+RTL on sable-v1 int8; fallback to fp16 enabled"
